blurb: Guests can rent skiffs, pontoons, and jet skis for exploring the Intracoastal Waterway and local waters. Rentals require valid driver's licenses and age minimums; no boater's license is needed. The marina also offers fueling, boat storage, and marine repair services.
extraNote: No ocean use permitted for boats or jet skis · Boating not allowed from 30 minutes before sunset to 30 minutes after sunrise · No smoking or vaping on rentals; intoxicated persons not allowed · Booking within 48 hours not available online; call marina to check availability · Cancellations made less than 7 days but more than 48 hours from reservation will recieve a 50% refund minus $30 processing fee. · Reservations cancelled for bad weather can be rescheduled to another date or fully refunded minus a $30 processing fee. · Spring and summer

quotes.text: I have kept my boat at Holden Beach Marina for several years and they have always done a great job. They get it in the water quickly and since I'm a senior boater, they are always there to help me a little extra. They are so kind and friendly and keep my boat all fixed up.

Holden Beach Marina has the best customer service, best facility, best workers and Jason is by far the best marina worker I have ever met. I wish I lived closer and that would be the home of my boats.
Had an issue with my boat. Stopped in for help. They hooked me right up and I got back on the water. The staff was super friendly, especially since I was never a customer here before.
Outstanding customer service from Will and his team. Had them paint our boat bottom with anti fouling paint. Job was completed on time and as per the estimate. Very happy.
Holden beach residents don’t know how lucky they are to have such a wonderful marina, I can promise you that you will not find that kind of service anywhere else!
Good price for non ethanol gas. Snacks for sale. Nice jets skis for rent. The staff couldn't be more friendly or helpful. I highly recommend them.
